title: XPENG Targets H2 2027 European Rollout for IRON Humanoid Robot
key_facts: XPENG is targeting the second half of 2027 for a European rollout of its IRON humanoid robot.
Founder and CEO He Xiaopeng presented the schedule at XPENG's Paris Night event on 11 Oct 2026.
Three milestones: mass production in late 2026, deliveries beginning in the first half of 2027, a European rollout in the second half.
Commercial applications come first; no dates were given for industrial and household uses, so the European target is not a commitment to sell IRON for home use in 2027.
XPENG did not say which European countries come first, the price or how IRON would be sold.

In September XPENG said its first commercial uses would be in its sales centres and on company premises (tours, shopping assistance, accompanying patrols), and that a completed robot had walked off an IRON production line, with more than 80% of core processes automated.
The Paris Motor Show runs 12 to 18 Oct 2026; XPENG shows humanoid robots there alongside cars and flying vehicles.
quote_evidence: XPENG is targeting the second half of 2027 for a European rollout of its IRON humanoid robot, adding a regional timetable to its previously announced plans for international deliveries next year.
XPENG did not specify which European countries would receive IRON first, its price or how it would be sold.
The Paris presentation places commercial applications ahead of industrial and household uses.
why_it_matters_hint: A carmaker is putting dates on selling a humanoid robot in Europe, but only as company targets with few details.
